gamerule.propwash.signal_repeaters.descr: How many signal repeaters may pass video and control on between pilot and drone in a row (at most 4). Each repeater reaches 128 blocks, and the signal goes through walls and ceilings just as it otherwise would; laps flown over repeaters count for leaderboards. 0 = repeaters off.
propwash.help.signal_repeater.fits: Analog and digital video, any radio
propwash.help.signal_repeater.use.1: Place on a floor, wall or ceiling.
propwash.help.signal_repeater.use.2: Chains of up to 4 repeaters (world rule).
propwash.help.signal_repeater.use.3: OSD "RPT": repeaters in use, signal per hop.
propwash.help.signal_repeater.use.4: Laps over repeaters count as usual.
propwash.help.signal_repeater.what.1: For big builds: concrete and floors swallow
propwash.help.signal_repeater.what.2: the video. One repeater at the stairwell
propwash.help.signal_repeater.what.3: carries the picture to the next floor.
